clue.text: An isolated community lives without scandal

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for lives wraps round the scandal

parts.note: he lives, she is: is means exists or lives
slander is malicious scandal spread about someone

explanation.surface: A remote community gets along without any gossip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking, which is what makes the surface read as a scandal-free community.
explanation.definitionFit: People living on an island form a community cut off by the sea.

clue.text: Not a particular individual

parts.note: some, as in some person or other, means not a particular one
one means a single individual

explanation.surface: A description of an ordinary, unremarkable person.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines, and its two halves also give the two parts of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun refers to an unspecified person, not any one in particular.

clue.text: Reason for strengthening attachment?

parts.note: sounds like something technical about fixings, but alludes to the proverb that being apart makes the heart grow fonder

explanation.walkthrough: 'Attachment' looks mechanical; it is affection, and the proverb says being away makes it stronger.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb holds that time spent apart makes affection grow fonder.

clue.text: Woman doctor out of order in America

indicators.note: in places the word for out of order inside the abbreviation for America

parts.note: USA, the United States of America
something out of order, unwell, is ill

explanation.surface: A female physician is unwell somewhere in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Drusilla is a woman's given name, so a woman fits as the definition by example.

clue.text: Pleasurable activities for good losers

definitions.meaning: games and pastimes done for enjoyment
people who take defeat well are called good ...

explanation.definitionFit: Games played for fun, and also people who take defeat graciously, both share this word.

clue.text: The law enforcer does make a list

parts.note: to do someone is to swindle or con them
to table is to set out in a list or tabular form

explanation.surface: A police officer does the paperwork of listing things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'does' is not the verb 'to do' as a helper but slang for swindles, CONS.
explanation.definitionFit: A police officer is a person who enforces the law.

clue.text: Told about everything in verse

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for told goes round the one for everything

parts.note: bade, past tense of bid, means told or ordered
all means everything

explanation.surface: Someone recounted the whole story in poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballade is a fixed form of poem, so a piece of verse.

clue.text: Fix and check and explosive device

parts.note: to deter is to check or hold back
a mine is a buried explosive device

explanation.surface: Repair and inspect a bomb.
explanation.definitionFit: To fix a date or price is to settle or decide it.

clue.text: Proof the head should carry rifle

indicators.note: carry means hold within, so the word for head contains the word for rifle

parts.note: pate is an old word for the head
to rifle a house is to rob it

explanation.surface: A soldier's head is told to bear a gun as evidence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rifle' looks like a gun but is the verb, to ransack.
explanation.definitionFit: A will is officially proved through this legal process, so it is proof of validity.

clue.text: Bad accident caused by many a mum in drink

indicators.note: in places the letters for many, a and mum inside the word for drink

parts.note: to sup is to drink
M, the Roman numeral for a thousand, stands for many
mum, as in keep mum, means silent; sh is the call for silence

explanation.surface: A crash is blamed on lots of mothers drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mum' is not a mother but silence, SH.
explanation.definitionFit: A pile-up or crash is a serious collision.

clue.text: Do the crossword again for 8

parts.note: re- is the prefix meaning again
doing a crossword means working it out: to solve it

explanation.surface: Tackle the puzzle a second time for clue 8.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is the answer to 8 Down, DETERMINE.
explanation.definitionFit: To make up one's mind firmly is to decide, the same as the earlier answer.

clue.text: Plain-spoken with depressed Tories

parts.note: feeling down is feeling depressed
the Tories are the political right

explanation.surface: Glum Conservatives speak bluntly.
explanation.definitionFit: Blunt, frank speech is utterly straightforward.

clue.text: The man's shown around at church but comes out

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the man's goes round at and church

parts.note: the man is he, so the man's is he's

explanation.surface: A man is given a tour of the church but then leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A chick breaks out of its egg, so to emerge.

clue.text: A pen responsible for the big hold-up in Egypt

definitions.text: A pen responsible for the big hold-up in Egypt

parts.note: a pen is a female swan
a dam holds up a river's flow

explanation.surface: A writing pen is blamed for a major robbery in Egypt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pen' is a female swan, and 'hold-up' is a barrage holding back the Nile, not a robbery.
explanation.definitionFit: This barrage across the Nile in southern Egypt holds back Lake Nasser.

clue.text: Have a fling, taking in a show

indicators.note: taking in means containing, so the word for have a fling holds the a

parts.note: to revel is to make merry, to have a fling

explanation.surface: Someone has a wild time while going to a show.
explanation.definitionFit: To show something is to disclose or uncover it.

clue.text: A demonstration of scorn for fruit

definitions.meaning: a rude noise made with the tongue and lips to show contempt

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a rude blown noise of contempt and a soft red berry.

clue.text: Insisting upon reform is strange

indicators.note: reform means form again, so the letters of is strange are rearranged

explanation.surface: Being insistent about reforming society is odd.
explanation.definitionFit: To insist upon one's rights is to declare them forcefully.

clue.text: Chaste characters needing money to get a bag

indicators.note: characters means the letters of chaste, taken in a new order

parts.note: L stands for pound, from the Latin libra

explanation.surface: Virtuous people need cash to buy a handbag.
explanation.definitionFit: A school bag with a shoulder strap is a kind of bag.

clue.text: Serving the Spanish with wrong mineral in Hamlet's castle

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
a sin is a wrong
ore is mineral-bearing rock

explanation.surface: A Spanish servant mixes up the minerals at Hamlet's home.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Danish prince lives at this castle, Kronborg in Helsingør.

clue.text: This might well be a target for sailing folk

definitions.text: This might well be a target for sailing folk

indicators.note: might well be suggests the letters of a target could become something else

explanation.surface: Sailors may aim at this.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might well be' signals an anagram of A TARGET.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat race meeting is the event sailing people aim for.

clue.text: Representative? A member scoffed

parts.note: a member is a limb, such as a leg
to scoff food is to eat it greedily: ate

explanation.surface: A delegate is told an MP gobbled the food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'member' looks parliamentary but is a limb.
explanation.definitionFit: A papal envoy is sent as a representative.

clue.text: Measured the little Greek with a double

parts.note: Gr is the short form of Greek
dual means double

explanation.surface: A Greek child is measured alongside a twin.
explanation.definitionFit: A measured pace is steady and slow, taken by degrees.

clue.text: Ramblers gain support here

parts.note: sounds like walkers being helped along, but means climbing rambling roses held up on a framework

explanation.definitionFit: A wooden lattice frame holds up climbing plants.

clue.text: Appearance of coppers round about head of state

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the coppers wrap about and the head of state

parts.note: coppers are low-value copper coins, pennies
re means about or concerning

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of state

explanation.surface: Police come to see a head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' are not police but pennies, PENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Being present or showing up is making an appearance.

clue.text: Calling for private transport always

parts.note: a car is a private means of transport
e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, always

explanation.surface: Someone phones for a private car every time.
explanation.definitionFit: A calling is a vocation or lifelong profession.

clue.text: Letters written as a priest perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters of as a priest could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Correspondence penned in the manner of a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: Breathed sounds like h are written with letters standing for that breath.

clue.text: He will no longer play Shylock

parts.note: ex- means former, no longer
one who plays parts on stage is an actor

explanation.surface: A performer retires and will no longer take the role of the Merchant of Venice moneylender.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He will no longer play' reads as a former actor; Shylock, Shakespeare's moneylender, is a name for any grasping lender.
explanation.definitionFit: A grasping moneylender who demands every penny owed is an extortioner.

clue.text: May be completely taken in!

parts.note: sounds like someone gullible being fooled, but describes a substance that can be fully absorbed into a liquid

explanation.definitionFit: Something able to dissolve can be wholly absorbed by a liquid.

clue.text: Re-unite possibly to make the train

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters of re-unite could make something else

explanation.surface: Bringing people back together to form a train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' is not a railway but a group of attendants.
explanation.definitionFit: A train of followers is the entourage attending an important person.

clue.text: Nobody up? No comment

parts.note: a rider is an added comment or clause
-less means without, no

explanation.surface: Is anyone awake? No reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' means in the saddle, not awake.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse with no one on its back carries nobody mounted.
